name: Estelle Ceulemans - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT with recommendations to the Commission on psychosocial risk, stress and mental health at work
part_text:
The European Parliament is asking the European Commission to propose a new EU law on work-related mental health. It wants binding minimum rules for employers: regular checks of stress risks, action plans, protection from harassment and violence, a right to switch off after hours, and support for people returning to work after stress or burnout. It also wants mental health problems caused by work recognised as occupational diseases, with easier proof for workers. The Commission must first assess the impact, especially on small businesses.

- **What changes:** New EU law would make employers assess and prevent work-related stress and mental health risks.
- **Who it affects:** All employers and workers in the EU, public and private, including small businesses.
- **What happens next:** The Commission must study the impact, then decide whether to propose the law.
